name: Daelin's Men
summary: Adjutant Tesoran has found Lieutenant Paval Reethe in the guard's records. They trace Reethe's service from enlistment in the Kul Tiras marines at sixteen, through promotions for distinguished service, to the Theramore guard with Lady Proudmoore's recruits. The final entry marks Reethe missing, and Captain Garran Vimes is to hear the news.

sections.title: What the Records Say
sections.body: Captain Garran Vimes sent you to Adjutant Tesoran, who searched the books and found Lieutenant Paval Reethe. Reethe enlisted in the Kul Tiras marines at sixteen, and distinguished service brought him promotions. Later, he joined the Theramore guard with most of the recruits who sailed over with Lady Proudmoore. The record ends by listing him as missing. Vimes, in Theramore, is to hear the news.

sections.title: The Captain's Reaction
sections.body: Captain Garran Vimes takes “missing” as Tesoran's kind word for traitor. He is sure Reethe is one of the fools whose blind loyalty to Admiral Daelin makes them turn traitor. Vimes sees bitter irony in this, since the deserters accuse Theramore of betraying the Alliance.

faq.answer: Adjutant Tesoran searched the guard's records for Lieutenant Paval Reethe and read out what they say.

faq.q: What do the records say about Paval Reethe?
faq.answer: Lieutenant Paval Reethe enlisted in the Kul Tiras marines at sixteen, earned promotions through distinguished service, and later joined the Theramore guard with the recruits who sailed over with Lady Proudmoore. The record ends by listing Reethe as missing.

faq.q: Who gets the news about Reethe?
faq.answer: Captain Garran Vimes gets the news in Theramore.
